{{Quote|Contained on it are designs for ''the most perfect series of battle droids'' ever conceived. They'll be unstoppable killing machines!|[[Unidentified Neimoidian councilor|A Neimoidian councilor]], to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="Update" />}}
This '''battle droid''' was an advanced type of<ref name="Update" /> [[Class four droid/Legends|class four droid]]<ref name="NEGD" /> [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was designed in an intent to replace the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Update" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Update]]" is set after "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]" ([[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]), as "[[Mandalorian Memories]]" serves as a prequel to the episode. Because the [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] featured in [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars Comic UK'']] are published in chronological order, "Update" must take place in 20 BBY.</ref> It was biped [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape and described as an unstoppable [[Death/Legends|killing]] machine.<ref name="Update" />

When the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] learned of its existence, they launched an [[Raid on a Separatist factory|attack]] on the [[Unidentified Separatist factory|factory]]. The battle droid army shot all the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and brought the plans, within a [[Datachip/Legends|data chip]], back to the Confederacy at a [[Unidentified Separatist asteroid base|Separatist asteroid base]]. They had not made extra copies as the risk was too dangerous. Upon hearing that the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s were to be outdated once the updated battle droid was to be produced, the [[Unidentified B1 battle droid (Separatist factory)|B1]] which brought it back fired on the console, destroying the plans so its platoon brothers would not be scrapped.<ref name="Update" />

{{Droid-stub}}

== Behind the scenes ==
This battle droid design is identical to the [[Eliminator 434-series assassin droid|Eliminator 434]] and [[Uulshos justice droid]] model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] as both are based on early concept art for [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]]. It is unknown if the updated battle droid shares any connection to the Eliminator or Uulshos droids.
